mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS on 20-day forward returns falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window or average 20-day return during declining FEDFUNDS is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 20-day forward return when UNRATE exceeds 4.0% is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal a contraction in consumer demand that reduces corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint decline of HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce negative 20-day returns in >60% of cases or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 4.5% sustained for 3 months), increased borrowing costs reduce corporate investment and consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 20-day forward return during tightening cycle is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals reduced manufacturing output that lowers corporate profits, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for INDPRO on 5-day forward returns falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window or average 5-day return during declining INDPRO is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) below 0.5% annualized signals economic slowdown that reduces corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 60-day forward return when GDPC1 growth is below 0.5% annualized is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high labor market slack regime (UNRATE above 4.5% and PAYEMS growth below 0.5% annually), reduced wage pressures and lower consumer spending cause negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 20-day forward return in defined regime is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC for regime condition falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained annualized CPI increase (CPIAUCSL) above 3.5% signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 20-day forward return when CPIAUCSL annualized exceeds 3.5% is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.
